name: attachment
title: Attachment
description: Displays file media, metadata, caller-owned upload state, and actions.

motionProfile.reason: Attachment coordinates one tile's presence, supplied media/state envelope, busy title, changed display text, direct quantities and its own measured box; the group keeps native scroll and snap placement.

data.transition/one-shot.reason: Attachment integrates its tile entrance, the later media/action regions and the current supplied media visual and state envelope; composed controls and rich child content retain their native owners.
AttachmentAction mounts Button on the same host, so Button keeps its own label and root transition instead of a second attachment writer.

exit.fade/one-shot.reason: Attachment integrates the tile exit and the media/action region exit on the same retained hosts; no outgoing interactive copy is created.
AttachmentAction keeps Button's own retained exit; Attachment never wraps the action host in a second opacity writer.

data.transition/continuous.reason: Attachment runs the busy title pulse through the shared continuous policy on the title's single opacity owner.

geometry.resize/measured.reason: Attachment owns its own content/orientation-driven box after commitment; the group writes no tile geometry and an explicit caller axis stays native.
AttachmentAction keeps Button's committed label box; Attachment measures only its own tile and never the shared action host.

text.change/changed-runs.reason: Attachment replaces changed runs in the plain filename and description displays; composed rich metadata keeps its own owner.
AttachmentAction's label text stays Button's own changed-run owner; Attachment replaces only its filename and description displays.

number.roll/reels.reason: Attachment reels direct display quantities in the description; names, extensions, ids and composed progress remain textual or composed.
AttachmentAction's numeric label content stays Button's own reel owner; Attachment reels only its direct description quantity.

state.color/css-transition.reason: Attachment owns the tile and media surface-foreground paint plus explicit title and description foreground; AttachmentAction delegates to Button.
AttachmentAction keeps Button's scoped colour clock on the same host; Attachment never writes the action surface or foreground.
